title.en: Friendly team with occasional customer frustrations

text.en: Long-term clients appreciate the friendly attitude and perseverance of the grooming team, noting consistent service over multiple years. Several pet parents highlight that groomers work hard to maintain records of previous haircut preferences. In contrast, one unhappy customer reported encountering an impatient groomer during a difficult appointment.

title.en: Reliable haircuts with occasional styling disputes

text.en: Most reviewers praise the salon for neat haircuts, thorough bathing, and the ability to work carefully through matted fur coats. Satisfied dog owners remark that their pets leave looking well styled and refreshed. However, a negative review noted an incomplete grooming session where the staff was unable to complete the service on a challenging dog.

Several clients note that groomers handle dogs with matted coats and specific grooming needs with perseverance and care. Pet owners appreciate that the salon takes time to work through difficult coat conditions. Nonetheless, one reviewer expressed disappointment when staff could not manage their dog behavior, emphasizing the importance of gentle handling.

q.en: Does Puff & Fluff Grooming Arcadia groom cats as well as dogs?

a.en: Yes, the salon offers grooming packages, baths, and deshedding services for both feline and canine pets.

q.en: Can groomers manage dogs with severely matted coats?

a.en: Clients report that groomers successfully worked through thick matted fur on Cocker Spaniels, though handling may depend on the pet temperament.

q.en: Is online booking supported at the Arcadia location?

a.en: Yes, pet owners can schedule grooming appointments directly through the salon online booking system.

q.en: How do clients evaluate the consistency of pet haircuts?

a.en: Several reviewers note that staff keep detailed records of previous cuts, resulting in consistent styling over repeat visits.
